html:
Question 12
?

Consider a function f(t) for which the Laplace transform is L{f(t)}=F(s). How can we obtain the graph of L{e5tf(t)} from the graph of F(s)?

a
Shift the graph of F(s) by 5 units to the right.
b
Scale the graph of F(s) by a scale factor of 5 horizontally.
c
Shift the graph of F(s) by 5 units to the left.
d
Scale the graph of F(s) by a scale factor of 5 vertically.
e
The Laplace transform is unchanged.
